extDescription.message: Fills in credentials from your local Kryptos vault. No server, no network.

footerText.message: Offline · your data never leaves the computer

unsupportedPageText.message: Open a login page to fill in your credentials.

vaultLockedText.message: Unlock it in the app to see passwords for this site.

appClosedText.message: Open the app on your computer and unlock the vault.

untrustedText.message: Kryptos refused the request because it couldn't verify the browser or extension. Use a supported browser and reconnect the app.

noLoginsText.message: Add a password for $SITE$ in Kryptos.

rateLimitedText.message: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a minute.

confirmInAppText.message: Kryptos asks you to confirm this fill.

fillBusyText.message: Another fill is already waiting for confirmation in Kryptos.

saveNothingText.message: Type your password in the login form first, then save.

unchangedText.message: This login is already in Kryptos.

lookalikeTitle.message: Watch out: this isn't the site you think

lookalikeText.message: It looks like $TITLE$ ($DOMAIN$) but it's a different address. Don't type your password here.

qrReadingText.message: Reading the visible page, nothing is saved.

qrNoneText.message: Open the page where the site shows the QR code to turn on two-step verification, make sure it's fully visible, and try again.

qrCaptureFailed.message: The browser didn't allow reading this page.

qrConfirmText.message: Choose in Kryptos which entry gets the 2FA code.

qrAddedText.message: Saved in $TITLE$. Kryptos will now fill it on this site.

qrDeniedText.message: Cancelled in Kryptos: nothing was saved.

qrInvalidText.message: That QR code doesn't contain a valid 2FA key.

searchAllHint.message: Type at least two letters. Results open in Kryptos; filling stays limited to each login's own site.

genInsertSave.message: Put in the form and save

genNoFieldText.message: Open the sign-up or change-password form first.

genInsertedText.message: Submit the form, then save it with 'Save login'.

commandFill.message: Fill this site's most recent login
